title: (Pwn2Own) Amazon Smart Plug OTA Update Process Out-Of-Bounds Write Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Amazon Smart Plug. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the processing of OTA updates. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a write past the end of data structure. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device.
